statement.name: Fixed-degree octic resultant against a monic square
statement.source: RecursiveSemaevDegreeAudit uses actual canonical resultants at every arity; this finite supplement checks only Res_(8,2)(sum a_i X^i,(X-z)^2)=(sum a_i z^i)^2, not the all-arity degree theorem.
